simple.meaning: מִסְפָּחָה (miçpâchâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a veil (as spread out).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִסְפָּחָה (H4555) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 13:18, with occurrences in Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִסְפָּחָה (H4555) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִסְפָּחָה (H4555) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִסְפָּחָה (miçpâchâh) / H4555 is traced through Ezekiel 13:18, Ezekiel 13:21 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4555. mispachah [ מִסְמָּחָה ] noun feminine long veil (properly sheathing?) covering whole person; plural absolute עַלרֿאֹשׁ הַמִּסְמָּחוֺת וְעשֹׁוֺת Ezek 13:18 ; suffix מִסְמְּחֹתֵיכֶם 13:21 . סִמַּי see ספף .

occurrences.englishText: and say, “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘Woe to the women who sew pillows on all elbows, and make kerchiefs for the head of persons of every stature to hunt souls! Will you hunt the souls of my people, and save souls alive for yourselves?
I will also tear your kerchiefs, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they will be no more in your hand to be hunted. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.
